items.title: Native Solana test-network acceptance (Block A)
items.blockedReason: Waiting for the next market-clock step. Program initialization and oracle registration executed on 2026-10-27, all read-back checks pass, and 9 of the 39 flow steps are done with the accounting balanced. Step 10, the first player withdrawal, can run no earlier than 2026-11-03 13:11 UTC and must run before 15:37 UTC that day on the network's own clock, because the plan expects the first-week Carried Interest rate. This clears when that window opens. No activation of Internet Computer services or real rewards is part of this work.
items.nextAction: In the window: run step 10, then the keeper's fee-ticket steps and the backer's first claim (steps 11 and 12). Gideon decides two open items: the optional oracle-client top-up and the governance waiting-period rehearsal.
